text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... phew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's not enough.
No matter how many times I do this, this heat...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Brian-chan.
Do you happen to need a running partner?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haah...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, so far ahead...!
Kuh... Brian-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Ahaha.
Too bad, I couldn't catch up to you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But next time, I will...
Hey, Brian-chan. One more time—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wait up—!! Stooop!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you startled me.
Fufu, what's the matter, Maya-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's not fair that just the two of you are having fun running!
Maya wants to run too! Let me join in!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Were you watching?
Do whatever you want. I won't stop you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you, Brian-san!
Maya's gonna sparkle bright together with you~!
The sound of the three of them running continued until evening—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haah...
You guys should rest now.
From here on, I'll run alone.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine...!
Phew... Yep! Maya can still keep running!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... haah...
...Kuh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, how frustrating.
But... that just proves how incredible you are...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Laurel.
You—
What on earth are you guys doing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I passed by earlier too, and you've been
running non-stop since broad daylight, haven't you?!
Call it quits already!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Auuu... But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry, Hishiama-chan.
Don't worry, we were just about to stop anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. Good, but... wait,
Brian, are you even listening?!
I'm talking to you too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
Just after I run one more—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Listen when people are talking to you!
That's it for today, done!
O-V-E-R!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A-Alright...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
............
...Fufu. Even Brian-chan is helpless
against Hishiama-chan, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It's not just that she's out of reach.
To become that single shining light,
I still have so many rivals to face.
